home.tagline: Find blood donors near the hospital, fast.

req.dont_know_help: Ask the hospital for the exact blood group. You can still see nearby blood banks.
req.note: Optional Note (No money or phone numbers)

banks.title: Nearest blood banks
banks.call_before_go: Stock changes quickly. Call before you go.

live.donor_revealed: Phone revealed. Tap to call directly.
live.waiting_answers: Waiting for nearby donors to answer calls and WhatsApp...

gate.title: Search further?
gate.body: We searched {from} km around the hospital. Continue to {to} km?
gate.body_100: Donors this far may take hours to reach you. Do you still want us to continue? Please also call the nearest large blood banks.

exhausted.title: We could not find enough donors
exhausted.body: Our team has been alerted. Please call the blood banks listed, the hospital's own blood centre, or the 108 ambulance helpline.

compat.prompt: No exact-group donor yet. Ask the doctor: can other compatible blood groups be used?

donor.not_eligible_now: You cannot donate right now. That is okay. Thank you for wanting to help.

common.safety: Blood never asks for money or OTP. The final health check is done by the doctor.

auth.otp_sent: We sent a 6-digit code on WhatsApp.

errors.phone_not_verified: Please verify your phone number first.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.duplicate_request: You already have an active request for this patient and hospital.
errors.service_paused: The service is paused for a short time. Please call the blood banks listed.
errors.invalid_input: Please check the details you entered.
errors.not_found_or_forbidden: We could not find this, or you do not have access.
errors.code_wrong: That code is not correct. Please check with the donor.
errors.code_locked: Too many wrong codes. Please try again in an hour.
errors.donor_not_eligible: You cannot donate right now. Thank you for wanting to help.
errors.provider_unavailable: We could not send messages right now. Our team has been alerted.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
